final.narration: This gauge can be trusted. Recent field measurements sit 7.0 % above the rating, so published flows are about that much too low, but this minor variation is close to typical scatter and well within normal operating limits. We are confident the rating remains reliable, supported by frequent recent site visits and no reported problems at the river control. Continue using the published flow data for routine utility operations as normal. Trust score 94/100 (Trusted).
